# For The Feast

> > A culinary journey through Italian-inspired recipes, European wine culture, and feast-worthy dishes by Carrie Pacini

For The Feast celebrates the art of gathering around exceptional food and wine, with a focus on Italian cuisine, French classics, and Southern comfort dishes. The site features recipes inspired by travels through Italy, France, and beyond, along with wine tasting experiences and travel stories.

## Key Topics

- Italian cuisine
- Carrie Pacini
- Italian-inspired recipes
- Béchamel sauce
- Burrata
- Afternoon tea
- Bread recipes
- Holiday side dishes
- Tuscany

- Southern recipes
- Wine tasting

- Thanksgiving
- Rustic bread

## Italian Pasta & Main Dishes

- [Rigatoni Bolognese with Ground Beef](https://www.forthefeast.com/rigatoni-bolognese): Rigatoni bolognese with ground beef and burrata topping for Sunday supper
- [Cannelloni with Ground Beef and Béchamel](https://www.forthefeast.com/cannelloni): Cannelloni with ground beef and béchamel sauce, easier than lasagna
- [Delicious Manicotti Recipes](https://www.forthefeast.com/manicotti-recipes): Italian-inspired manicotti recipes with customizable cheese fillings
- [Spaghetti Arrabbiata: Spicy Pasta Dish](https://www.forthefeast.com/spaghetti-arrabbiata): Easy spaghetti arrabbiata with spicy red pepper flakes from Rome
- [Frutti di Mare Seafood Pasta](https://www.forthefeast.com/frutti-di-mare): Italian frutti di mare seafood pasta with shellfish and spaghetti

## Appetizers & Small Plates

- [Burrata Appetizer - Easy for Gatherings](https://www.forthefeast.com/burrata-appetizer): Easy burrata appetizer with caramelized apricots from Southern Italy
- [Smoked Salmon Pinwheels](https://www.forthefeast.com/smoked-salmon-pinwheels): Smoked salmon pinwheels for afternoon tea and holiday appetizers
- [Pierini Sandwiches from Harry's Bar Venice](https://www.forthefeast.com/pierini-sandwiches): Pierini sandwiches from Harry's Bar Venice with Gruyere cheese
- [Missing Rome and the Zucchini Blossoms](https://www.forthefeast.com/missing-rome): Fried zucchini blossoms recipe inspired by Rome travel memories

## Breads & Baked Goods

- [Recipe for Italian Bread](https://www.forthefeast.com/recipe-for-italian-bread): Simple Italian bread recipe inspired by Tuscan rustic bread traditions
- [Mini Herb and Buttermilk Cornbreads](https://www.forthefeast.com/mini-herb-and-buttermilk-cornbreads): Mini herb and buttermilk cornbreads for fall and winter stews
